--[[
    VEXIS PROTECTED GUARD // NIVEL: ADVANCED
    Universal Security Wrapper
]]--

local _VexisLevel = "advanced"
local _VexisPayload = ""

local function _vexisRun()
    local data = _VexisPayload
    if _VexisLevel == "medium" then
        local b=''
        for i = #data, 1, -1 do b = b .. data:sub(i,i) end
        data = b
    elseif _VexisLevel == "advanced" then
        data = data:gsub('.', function(c) return string.char(c:byte() - 2) end)
    end
    local b='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    local function decode(d)
        d = string.gsub(d, '[^'..b..'=]', '')
        return (d:gsub('.', function(x)
            if (x == '=') then return '' end
            local r,f='',(b:find(x)-1)
            for i=6,1,-1 do r=r..(f%2^i-f%2^(i-1)>0 and '1' or '0') end
            return r;
        end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
            if (#x ~= 8) then return '' end
            local c=0
            for i=1,8 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(8-i) or 0) end
            return string.char(c)
        end))
    end
    local realCode = decode(data)
    return loadstring(realCode)()
end

pcall(_vexisRun)
